name: my-workflow
description: A spec-driven software workflow for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. drive-spec turns a request into a spec and leads it to a verified, reviewed change in your session, running only the steps a task needs, keeping spec.md and design.md under specs/<task>/, and bringing in the spec-architect, spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-reviewer agents only when they pay off. Every other skill does one step, works alone and returns its result: rephrase (a prompt or the conversation, grounded in what it names), discuss (an open discussion that drafts a direction), audit-truth (facts and claim checks), decide (approach or stack, structure, components, contracts, UI state), build, verify (acceptance checks), critique (verified review on quality axes). code-auditor builds a grounded-truth atlas of a codebase that later sessions read first. Adapts to how much you specify; uses the stack knowledge you have installed.
